summary: Clear all Map entries without invalidating the live iteration sequence semantics of already-created iterators.

semantics.existing_iterators: removed entries are skipped; later appended entries may still be observed by unfinished iterators

caveats: Replacing the underlying collection object can break existing iterator behavior.

tests.name: unfinished iterator sees post-clear append
tests.input: const m=new Map([['a',1],['b',2]]); const it=m.keys(); it.next(); m.clear(); m.set('c',3); console.log(it.next().value);
